desc: Test with sample input 1 (N=4, P=998244353) and compare output to "12 9 3 0".
Test with sample input 2 (N=6, P=924844033) and compare output to "810 2100 3060 3030 2230 1210 450 100 10 0 0".
Test with sample input 3 (N=10, P=433416647) and compare output to the given 36 numbers.
If any test fails, debug the DP logic: check initialization, transition, termination, and state propagation.
Verify that the bipartite graph counts bp[a][b][t] are correctly computed via inclusion-exclusion and that t is within bounds.
Ensure that the final answer only includes states with v=N and k_even=N/2, and that the edge count M is within [N-1, maxM].
Optimize memory usage if needed (though N ≤ 30 should be fine).
Confirm that the output format is a single line with space-separated values.
